name: time_uploaded
description: The time at which the document was uploaded

name: time_processed
description: The time at which the document finished processing

name: document_path
description: Cloud Storage path to the document

name: auth_url
description: Authentication URL for accessing the document

name: uploader
description: Email address of the user or service account that uploaded the document

name: file_size_bytes
description: Size of the original file in bytes

name: text_length_chars
description: Length of the extracted text in characters

name: parent_folders
description: Array of parent folder names in the path, ordered from top to bottom

name: file_name
description: Name of the file without the path
